name: David Lawford
source:
A young agent from the USA, he was hired by Suzumi to observe the Phantom case and report back his findings to create sample cases for future reference.

He tends to annoy Akito the most, which pleases Kazumi at times.
He seems to get lost often, but always finds a way back to the action.
